argument_boundaries.optional_argument: wyag ls-tree -r HEAD (succeeds with recursive tree entries)
argument_boundaries.invalid_combination: wyag ls-tree (fails with status 2, usage message, no state change)
argument_boundaries.nonexistent_tree: wyag ls-tree nonexistent_sha (fails non-zero, diagnostic message)

normalization: Baseline commit dates and author/committer identity are fixed.
Timestamps and author metadata are normalized across Git and wyag.
